pages.text: A 3x3x3 of $(item)Reactor Casing$() around an empty middle, with the $(item)Fusion Reactor Controller$() in the middle of one face, facing out.$(br2)The other face centres can be casing, $(item)Reactor Glass$() (to see the core) or $(item)Reactor Ports$(). Ports can also go on the edges.

pages.name: Fusion Reactor
pages.text: Click Visualize to see where each block goes in the world.

Ports take $(item)Fusion Fuel Pellets$() and plasma on their Input faces, and give power and tritium on their Output faces.$(br2)To start it, feed it about 1,000 mB of plasma with pellets inside. Once hot, it burns a pellet every ten seconds and breeds some tritium back.
